name: 马尔科·卡瓦津
awards: 2026年 第79届洛迦诺国际电影节 明日之豹 国际竞赛最佳导演 异变
name_full: 马尔科·卡瓦津 Marco Cavazzin
introduction: Marco Cavazzin is an Italian director and screenwriter. Since 2019, he has been working as a director and editor in the commercial and music industries. He worked on international projects including Alfonso Cuarón’s Apple series Disclaimer and, more recently, the Venice shoot of the second season of The Studio. His debut fiction short film Mutrion stars Manfredi Marini and Giulio Maroncelli.
